info.title: Email Verifier: Bulk Email Validation, MX & Disposable Check
info.description:
Validate a list of email addresses without sending mail. It checks the syntax, the domain, MX records and disposable domains, not the mailbox, plus role accounts, SPF/DMARC and typo fixes, with a verdict per email. This Actor checks the domain, MX records and disposable domains, not the mailbox. It does not send mail and is not a mailbox verifier.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/email-verifier
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/email-verifier
Author: Public Records.

  "title": "Email Verifier",

  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "emails": {
      "title": "Emails",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Email addresses to check, one per line (up to 10,000 per run). Duplicates are checked once. No email is sent.",

        "someone@no-such-domain-4k7q.com"

      "default": [
        "support@apify.com",
        "jane.doe@gmial.com",
        "info@mailinator.com",
        "sales@stripe.com",
        "someone@no-such-domain-4k7q.com"
      ]
    },
    "dnsServers": {
      "title": "DNS servers (optional)",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "IP addresses of DNS resolvers to use, e.g. 1.1.1.1. Leave empty to use the platform resolver.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "sectionCaption": "Advanced"
